purpose: Reject hard duplicates and cosmetic-only variations. Aligned with layered uniqueness @1.1.0 — not blanket semantic cluster max=1.

hardRejectIf.description: Same combined semantic signature after normalisation; only names, dates, phones, case IDs, or salts differ.
Same combined signature and evidence states; only rotation, OCR crush, duplicate page, or whitespace noise differs, with no new assertion.
Base skeleton reused while appending a trap label that does not change any truth-keyed finding, absence, relationship edge, or expected CaseBrain behaviour.
Matter in shard A duplicated into shard B with cosmetic edits to meet local floors.
Two matters identical except planned exit flags.
Same matter labelled easy vs moderate without document/page/conflict changes that justify the tier.
Offence family token changed without charge instrument, facts, or evidence changes.
Reuse of first-census or diverse-second membership IDs or sealed-holdout identities as if new.
Mutating protected heavy-pilot blueprints to inflate volume cases.
Identical combined semantic signature after normalisation (cosmetics excluded). Replaces withdrawn blanket near-duplicate cluster max=1.
Duplicate caseId, packetHash, completeSourceFingerprint, or completeOutputFingerprint.
Document-graph, evidence-graph, or combined-signature largest cluster share exceeds stratum dominance cap.

withdrawnHardRejects.reason: Too strict; punished legitimate single-dimension and public-form clustering.

softRejectUnlessNewAssertionDocumented.requiredDelta: Must differ on at least two L7 axes: facts, parties/attribution, evidence states, contradictions, document relationships, procedure, defence, missing material, expected CaseBrain behaviour.
Must differ on at least two L7 axes (not merely layout primary or cosmetic wording).

allowedSimilarButDistinct: Same offence family with different operative counts and different evidence-service graphs
Same primary home with different complexity justified by page/doc/conflict load
Same layout class with different truth-keyed absences or attribution edges
Shared MG/public form structures with different matter facts and relationships
Shared defence position or procedural stage across many routine matters
Shared document-graph or evidence-graph within stratum dominance caps
Repeated universal safety wording measured separately
